unmapped: Arm set is an arbitrary compact (finite or infinite) subset of R^d with ||x|| <= 1
Noise is a martingale difference sequence, conditionally R-subgaussian
settings.definition_quote: Let $\X \subset \Re^d$ be an arbitrary (finite or infinite) set of arms. When an arm $x\in\X$ is pulled, a reward is generated as $r(x) = x^\transp \theta^\star + \xi$, where $\theta^\star\in\Re^d$ is a fixed but unknown parameter and $\xi$ is a zero-mean noise. ... The arm set $\X$ is a bounded closed (and hence compact) subset of $\mathbb{R}^d$ such that $\|x\| \leq 1$ ... There exists $S\in\Re^+$ such that $\|\theta^\star\| \leq S$ and $S$ is known.

unmapped: Link function mu continuously differentiable, k_mu-Lipschitz, derivative lower bounded by c_mu > 0
Arm set compact subset of unit ball
settings.definition_quote: Every time an arm $x\in\X$ is pulled, a reward is generated as $r(x) = \mu(x^\transp \theta^\star) + \xi$, where $\mu$ is the so-called \textit{link function} ... The link function $\mu : \mathbb{R} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ is continuously differentiable, Lipschitz with constant $k_\mu$ and such that $c_\mu = \inf_{\theta \in \mathbb{R}^d, x \in \mathcal{X}} (x^\transp \theta) > 0$.

source.label: th:regret_ts
source.quote: Under assumptions~\ref{asm:arm.set},\ref{asm:param.set},\ref{asm:subgaussian}, the regret of \ts is bounded w.p. $1-\delta$ as ($\delta^\prime = \frac{\delta}{4T}$) R(T) \leq \big(\beta_T(\delta^\prime) +  \gamma_T(\delta^\prime)(1 + \frac{4}{p}) \big) \sqrt{ 2 T d \log \big( 1 + \frac{T}{\lambda} \big) } + \frac{4 \gamma_T(\delta^\prime)}{p} \sqrt{\frac{8 T } {\lambda} \log \frac{4}{\delta} }.

results.notes: Paper presents this as an alternative proof matching Agrawal & Goyal; is_new set false since the bound itself is not new, though the proof is. R (noise) mapped to sigma. Order Õ(d^{3/2} sqrt(T)).

source.label: th:regret_ts
source.quote: As anticipated in introduction, this bound is of order $\wt{O}(d^{3/2}\sqrt{T})$ and it entirely matches the result of~\citet{agrawal2012thompson}.

symbols.c_mu: lower bound on derivative of link function

source.label: p:generalized_regret
source.quote: Under assumptions~\ref{asm:arm.set},\ref{asm:param.set},\ref{asm:subgaussian} and~\ref{asm:link.function}, the cumulative regret of \ts over $T$ steps is bounded as R^{\text{GLM}}(T) \leq \frac{k_\mu}{c_\mu} \big(\beta_T(\delta^\prime) +  \gamma_T(\delta^\prime)(1 + 2/p) \big) \sqrt{ 2 T d \log \big( 1 + \frac{T}{\lambda} \big) } + \frac{2 k_\mu\gamma_T(\delta^\prime)}{p c_\mu} \sqrt{\frac{8 T } {\lambda} \log \frac{4}{\delta} } with probability $1-\delta$ where $\delta^\prime = \frac{\delta}{4T}$.

results.notes: Lemma numbering inferred from shared counter (4th lemma). Proof is a sketch; constants differ from Theorem 1 (2/p vs 4/p) as stated. Possibly whether gamma_T includes 1/c_mu factor is ambiguous.
